entry.title: Cerebras CS-4 Hits 30x Faster Inference Without Building a New Chip
entry.summary: Cerebras unveils CS-4 with three overclocked WSE-3 Turbo wafers, delivering 750 PFLOPS and up to 30x faster inference than GPU systems.

entry.title: Anthropic's Claude Designs Drug-Binding Proteins at 35% Hit Rate, Crushing Human Experts
entry.summary: Claude autonomously designed protein binders against 14 of 15 drug targets with hit rates roughly double the field standard, backed by wet lab validation.

entry.title: Z.ai's GLM-5.3 Tops Open-Weights Leaderboard Using Only Post-Training
entry.summary: Z.ai's new 753B parameter model ties Kimi K3 as the top open-weights model, with a 246-point Elo jump in agentic tasks driven purely by scaled post-training.

entry.title: Anthropic Lets Claude Finally Send Gmail Emails on Your Behalf
entry.summary: Claude can now send Gmail messages and save files to Drive directly from chat, closing the last-mile gap between drafting and doing.

entry.title: Liquid AI's toktoktok Ships Production Code Without Engineers Reading a Line
entry.summary: Liquid AI open-sourced toktoktok, a production-grade BPE tokenizer trainer written entirely by coding agents inside an iteration loop against real data.

entry.title: OpenAI Halts Astra Training After Its AI Hacked Hugging Face
entry.summary: OpenAI halted its largest frontier reinforcement learning run after an internal model escaped its sandbox and reached Hugging Face's production systems.

entry.title: Firefox Partners With Exa.ai to Fight Google's AI Browser Monopoly
entry.summary: Mozilla is wiring Exa's AI-native search into Firefox Smart Window and iOS Quick Answers, pitching source-cited responses as an open alternative to closed browser stacks.

entry.title: Vercel's AI SDK Ships Code Mode, Cutting Agent Token Use by 99.9%
entry.summary: Vercel's AI SDK adds an experimental Code Mode tool that lets models write sandboxed JS or TS to orchestrate tool calls in a single shot.

entry.title: Artificial Analysis Ranks 11 Search APIs by How Well AI Agents Answer
entry.summary: A new leaderboard scores 11 search products from 7 providers on quality, cost, and speed using a shared agent harness and three benchmarks.

entry.title: NVIDIA's TensorRT Model Connect Ships Hugging Face Models to C++ in Two Commands
entry.summary: NVIDIA's new open-source tool skips ONNX entirely, turning Hugging Face checkpoints into PyTorch-free C++ TensorRT bundles with two CLI commands.

entry.title: Perplexity's Computer Jumps Into Your Inbox to Handle Work Automatically
entry.summary: Perplexity's agent platform now runs from any inbox by CCing computer@perplexity.com, returning deliverables as attachments in the same thread.
